name: RSS and Atom
author: Jacob Vincent-Mink
description: Adds bounded new-entry and priority-keyword context from one configured RSS or Atom feed.

categories.label: New entries
categories.description: Feed entries published or updated in the requested digest window.

categories.label: Priority keyword matches
categories.description: New entries matching one of the configured case-insensitive keywords.

setup.summary: Fetches one credential-free HTTPS RSS or Atom URL. Private-network addresses and cross-origin redirects are rejected.

fields.label: Feed URL
fields.description: A public HTTPS RSS or Atom URL without embedded credentials.

fields.label: Priority keywords
fields.description: Optional comma-separated case-insensitive keywords (maximum 10) used for priority matching.
